subject: Make orchestrator hooks Windows-portable (replace Unix ps process checks)
description:
CRITICAL cross-platform infra fix. The daemon respawn-storm on Windows (root-caused in note:note-mqpd82jw9j3) is because two hook helpers shell out to the Unix `ps` command, which throws on Windows so their try/catch returns false:

1. hooks/start-daemon.js `hasDaemonProcess()` (uses `ps -axo pid=,command=`) — always returns false on Windows, so the SessionStart hook believes no daemon exists and spawns a duplicate `node daemon.js` every time the live daemon misses the 300ms /ping (e.g. while loading the big graph). Duplicates can't bind port 8787 and hang → 280+ accumulated.
2. lib/headless-ancestor.js `hasHeadlessDrainAncestor()` (uses `ps -o command=/-o ppid=`) — same Unix-only dependency, so the drain-ancestor guard is also dead on Windows.

FIX (no behavior change on POSIX):
- Add a shared cross-platform process-enumeration helper (e.g. lib/proc-list.js) returning {pid,ppid,command}: `ps` on POSIX; on win32 use PowerShell `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process` (ProcessId/ParentProcessId/CommandLine) via execFileSync (wmic is removed on newer Windows). Keep execFileSync INJECTABLE for tests (lib/headless-ancestor.js already does opts.execFileSync).
- Refactor both helpers to use it. For hasDaemonProcess(), ALSO treat 'port 8787 is held' as daemon-present (cross-platform) — the daemon binds the port before it can answer /ping, and that load window is exactly when the storm fires.
- grep hooks/ and lib/ for any other `ps ` process checks and fix them too; keep hooks/orch-gate.sh/.js shell-core parity.
- Add tests with INJECTED execFileSync (synthetic POSIX + Windows output) — must not depend on a real ps/PowerShell.

Implement + test on the attempt branch ONLY. Do NOT merge to main — human approves the main merge (critical cross-harness infra).

summary: Fixed Windows-portability bugs in orchestrator daemon/drain hooks. Created lib/proc-list.js — a shared cross-platform process enumerator: POSIX uses `ps -eo pid=,ppid=,command=`; Win32 uses PowerShell `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process` with pipe-delimited output (no wmic). execFileSync is injectable for tests. Refactored lib/headless-ancestor.js to use listProcs() instead of direct `ps -o` calls — builds a pid→entry Map once per call, then walks the parent chain from it (one subprocess call vs. one per hop). Added TCP port-bound check to hooks/start-daemon.js hasDaemonProcess() (now async): attempts net.createServer() bind on 8787; EADDRINUSE means daemon holds the port during its startup window, preventing the respawn storm. PID-file check unchanged (process.kill(pid,0) is already cross-platform). Added test/proc-list.test.js with 27 tests covering: _parsePosixOutput, _parseWindowsOutput, listProcs with injected stubs, isHeadlessDrainCommand, hasHeadlessDrainAncestor on both platform-shaped synthetic trees, error fallback paths. All 27 tests pass. git diff --check: no whitespace errors.
